decisions.reason: Applying help labels to all control fields does not change the requirement that Title fields preserve their formatting.
The checklist remains the required control type; help-label coverage is independently represented by the source Requirement.
The dropdown control and its document context remain unchanged; the source decision only expands the separate help-label Requirement.
Help-label coverage does not resolve or alter the separate requirement for visible fillable-field cues.
Adding help labels to control fields does not change how placeholder text must clear when a field is activated.
The robust placeholder mechanism remains valid unchanged; field help labels are a separate behavior.
The calendar-style date input method remains unchanged even if its control field is covered by the separate help-label Requirement.
The theme-color requirement is unaffected; its historical message merely mentioned interactive-field labels as another missing style element.
Help-label coverage does not change the Enter-key behavior for structured list fields.
